solnce.name: Sun
blocks: Will, vitality, consciousness, creativity.
The drive to be oneself, express oneself, and take one’s place.
The Sun shows the core of personality, a sense of purpose, the mode of self-expression, and the area in which a person needs to shine.
Dignity, generosity, confidence, creativity.
Pride, egocentrism, dependence on recognition.
‘I am.’

luna.name: Moon
blocks: Emotions, intuition, memory, habits, care, cycles.
Receptivity and a need for home, closeness, and emotional security.
The Moon describes automatic reactions, the inner child, the relationship with the maternal image, and ways of restoring strength.
Empathy, warmth, adaptability, a rich imagination.
Changeability, touchiness, anxious attachment, living in the past.
‘I feel.’

merkurij.name: Mercury
blocks: Thinking, speech, learning, exchanging information, mobility.
Curiosity, observation, and the ability to connect facts and people.
Mercury describes a person’s style of thinking, communication, learning, negotiation, and everyday decision-making.
Clarity, flexibility, wit, sociability.
Restlessness, cunning, superficiality, nervousness.
‘I think.’

venera.name: Venus
blocks: Love, beauty, pleasure, harmony, value, and exchange.
A need to be liked, connect, and choose what is pleasant and meaningful.
Venus shows a person’s relationship style, aesthetic taste, and attitude toward money, comfort, and self-worth.
Tact, tenderness, attractiveness, the ability to create harmony.
Dependence on approval, jealousy, passivity, excess.
‘I value and attract.’

zemlja.name: Earth
blocks: Matter, the body, nature, stability, practical embodiment.
Realism and a need for security and connection with the body and the surrounding world.

In geocentric astrology, Earth is not usually interpreted as a separate planet in the natal chart. Within Western esotericism, it symbolizes the ability to ground ideas, care for the body, and turn an intention into a result.
Reliability, patience, fruitfulness, environmental awareness.
Inertia, materialism, fear of change, excessive control.
‘I embody.’

mars.name: Mars
mars.tagline: Action, passion, the will to win
blocks: Impulse, passion, courage, struggle, sexuality, boundaries.
Directness, determination, competitiveness, a drive to act.
Mars shows how a person pursues what they want, defends themselves, expresses anger, and manages physical energy.
Courage, initiative, endurance, healthy assertiveness.
Aggression, conflict, impatience, destructive risk.
‘I act.’

jupiter.name: Jupiter
blocks: Expansion, faith, wisdom, luck, education, distant horizons.
Optimism, generosity, a desire to understand the world and develop.
Jupiter indicates where opportunities, support, authority, and a broader view are easier to find; it is connected with worldview and mentorship.
Generosity, hope, mature faith, strategic thinking.
Overconfidence, excess, moralizing, promises without measure.
‘I grow and believe.’

saturn.name: Saturn
blocks: Time, law, responsibility, limitations, discipline, karma.
Seriousness, caution, patience, a need for order.
Saturn marks areas of tests and fears in which work, boundaries, and experience form inner support and mastery.
Reliability, endurance, professionalism, wise boundaries.
Rigidity, pessimism, suppression, fear of mistakes and change.
‘I build and take responsibility.’

uran.name: Uranus
blocks: Renewal, independence, insight, change, technology, rebellion.
Originality, unpredictability, rejection of restrictive limits.
Uranus shows where a person seeks freedom from convention, thinks differently, and makes abrupt but renewing changes.
Inventiveness, honesty with oneself, a reforming outlook.
Chaos, cold detachment, rebellion for its own sake.
‘I set myself free.’

neptun.name: Neptune
blocks: Mysticism, compassion, imagination, dreams, unity, illusions.
Subtle sensitivity, romanticism, attraction to the ideal and the unseen.
Neptune shows an area of inspiration, spiritual searching, and strong receptivity, but also possible self-deception and blurred boundaries.
Intuition, mercy, artistic gifts, spiritual openness.
Escapism, dependencies, self-sacrifice, confusion.
‘I connect with the unseen.’

pluton.name: Pluto
blocks: Death and rebirth, depth, power, crisis, purification.
Intensity, insight, a drive to reach the hidden essence.
Pluto is connected with radical inner change, control, taboos, loss, and the recovery of personal power.
Resilience, psychological depth, the ability to heal and renew oneself.
Obsession, manipulation, power struggles, fear of losing control.
‘I transform.’

hiron.name: Chiron
blocks: Vulnerability, healing, mentorship, joining opposites.
A particular sensitivity to one’s own sense of ‘inadequacy’ and an ability to understand another person’s pain.
Chiron points to an enduring inner wound that may not disappear entirely but can become a source of wisdom, a gift for helping, and self-acceptance.
Healing ability, humor, compassion, the ability to accompany others.
Fixation on pain, the role of rescuer or victim, avoidance of closeness.
‘I heal through acceptance.’

prozerpina.name: Proserpina
blocks: Deep restructuring, analysis, purification, dissolution, and reassembling the whole.
Attention to detail, the ability to see hidden connections and alter an inner structure.

In some modern spiritual schools of the Eastern European esoteric tradition, Proserpina is associated with prolonged alchemical transformation, service, recovery after crisis, and transition to a new level of wholeness. (A feature of the Eastern European esoteric tradition.)
Insight, regeneration, precision, the ability to transform systems.
Excessive criticism, compulsive analysis, coldness, destruction for the sake of ‘purification.’
‘I purify and reassemble.’

catalog_disclaimer: Proserpina is a hypothetical point used in the Eastern European esoteric tradition and is not a recognized astronomical object; interpretations differ among modern spiritual schools. Chiron is astronomically classified as a small Solar System body. The Sun is a star and the Moon is Earth’s satellite, although traditional astrology conventionally groups them with the planets as significant factors in the natal chart. These descriptions are symbolic and are not scientific explanations of personality or fate. This material is not a diagnosis or financial advice. (A feature of the Eastern European esoteric tradition.)
